messages:
Samir: FYI - noticed a spike of gpu warmup failures in us-west-2 starting 02:33 UTC, roughly 28% join failures. Root cause looks like ephemeral-keystore calls timing out and a new egress circuitbreaker routing to penaltybox.
Jordan: ugh. Which rollout changed the breaker?
Samir: Keystore proxy rollout at 02:30 UTC. New global egress circuitbreaker threshold = 120 qps/az. Audit-shipper bursted while backfilling and we hit it.
Ashley: Any 5xx from keystore-proxy or just timeouts?
Samir: Mostly timeouts and dial tcp i/o timeouts. Sample snippet:
```
2026-03-23T02:34:12Z keystore-proxy timeout for gpu-node-42: dial tcp 10.0.5.42:443: i/o timeout
2026-03-23T02:34:13Z circuitbreaker tripped for keystore-usw2-azb
```
Lisa: When in penaltybox nodes can't fetch ephemeral keys for disk decryption -> failed joins/evictions for warmup tier. We should avoid evicting warmup hosts on keystore timeouts.
Jordan: Immediate mitigation options: 1) temporarily raise egress quota for audit-shipper in us-west-2 2) relax circuitbreaker threshold to 200 qps 3) flip audit-shipper to write-direct-to-s3 to avoid keystore calls. Thoughts on cost/risk?
Pete: Cost estimate: full egress bump +50% for 2h ~= $2.5k. Targeted whitelist for audit-shipper ~ $900. Bump is fine from incident ops budget if needed.
Ashley: Config flag exists to short-circuit audit shipper to s3 (--audit-direct-s3). Can do a canary flip quickly.
Samir: I can open a canary deploy now. Need Jordan approval for the quick change.
Jordan: approve. Canary at 10% first. Monitor keystore latency, kv-cache hit rate, and join success.
Deploy-bot: Deploy started by Samir at 02:51 UTC: canary 10% audit-direct-s3
Samir: Canary shows keystore call volume down 85% for canary hosts; warmup join success back to baseline, circuitbreaker no longer tripping for those hosts.
Lisa: Good. Follow-ups: a) add metric egress.circuitbreaker.penaltybox.rate b) change warmup host behavior to not evict on ephemeral-keystore timeouts (treat as degraded instead) c) revisit audit-shipper backpressure and batching.
Jordan: I'll file ENGINFRA-7893 for the warmup eviction policy change and link to this thread. Samir to PR the audit-direct-s3 toggle and a longer-term keystore retry/backoff patch.
Samir: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/keystore-proxy/pull/512 - tests passing, will merge after one more review.
Pete: Charging to incident ops budget. Agreed cap $3k for emergency egress increases — we'll use whitelist option first.
Ashley: I'll update the runbook under "egress circuitbreaker" with the canary steps and cost decision matrix.
Samir: Marking this resolved pending PR merge and 24h stable metrics. Thanks all :thumbsup:
